notes.title: Mars Attracts Hotfix 1
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
- Autosave during missions
- More music variation

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Resolution not setting correctly for some screens
- Steam achievements not triggering immediately
- Characters getting stuck on vending machines & fountains
- Janitors getting stuck on bridges
- Some humans invincible when escaping
- Some humans not returned to enclosure after being stunned
- Paid decor unlocks not saving
- Pause menu performance issue

notes.title: Updated Discord Supporter's Link
notes.content:
- Fixed expired Supporter's Edition Discord link in main menu
- Updated localization for Space Age enclosure unlock

notes.title: Want to be part of Mars Attracts? Record your 'Ack's!
notes.content:
[h3]We want your best ACKS for Mars Attracts![/h3]

Mars Attracts currently sounds a little quiet, and we would like your help filling out the ambient soundscape with your best impression of a Martian guest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157509/5db61cf40b7b6c13b4422cf5f5019d221c06f8dc.jpg[/img]

To get involved, all you need to do is send us short audio clips of your best attempt at the infamous “Ack Ack” sound. The samples you send us will be used as background sound effects to fill out the park -- it won't be replacing the main voiceover work. We're still working on that but we'll have more details to share soon!

[h3]Head on over to [url=https://www.marsattracts.com/ack]MarsAttracts.com/Ack[/url] for full details and submission instructions![/h3]

If you have any questions or need more information, come and [url=https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq]chat to us on Discord[/url].

Looking forward to hearing your very best Acks!

notes.title: Mars Attracts Devlog 07 - Lessons From The Alpha Playtest
notes.content:
Hey Martians and Martianettes,

We wanted to say a huge thankyou to everyone who participated in the Alpha Playtest! We received loads of fantastic feedback, bug reports, and new ideas to integrate into the game. We're trying to make Mars Attracts something really special, and having so many people engage with the game and share suggestions at an early stage is a HUGE help. Thank you! 💗

We've just released a video summarizing the key data points and learnings - check it out:
[previewyoutube=gd0v7rmbX4I;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be implementing some of the most common feature requests right away:
[list]
[*]Move objects after they're placed
[*]More visibility over urgent character needs
[*]Better tools to manage human escapes
[/list]

And will be focused on two big areas for the next phase of development:
[list]
[*]System complexity - adding new and deeper systems that intertwine to form interesting gameplay opportunities.
[*]Differentiation - leaning into the darkness of the IP, as well as the things that make the concept unique vs other park builders.
[/list]

Thanks again for all of your input - this really is the best stage of development as we overhaul the roadmap based on your suggestions. If you have any more ideas, or would like to chat to us directly about the game, [url=https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq]join us on Discord[/url]!

Love,

Outlier

notes.title: Last Chance To Apply For The Alpha Playtest!
notes.content:
With just a few more days before the launch of the first Alpha Playtest, now's the time to apply! The Playtest will be running from the 4th to the 8th of December so sign up to avoid missing out.

[h2]Head over to [url=https://www.MarsAttracts.com]www.MarsAttracts.com[/url] to sign up now.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=rauePFOLLBo;full]Trailer[/previewyoutube]

Be warned, this is not a typical 'test the servers before launch' type of playtest. We'll be running something like that next year. This is very much an [b]ALPHA[/b] - we'd love to integrate players early in the development cycle so we can make meaningful changes to the game based on your feedback. Expect some bugs, performance issues, and missing/incomplete features. If that doesn't sound like your cup of tea don't worry - there'll be plenty more opportunities to play before launch 🙂

We're super excited to hear what you think of the game, and chat more about ideas for development! Head over to [url=https://www.marsattracts.com]www.MarsAttracts.com[/url] to apply, and be sure to visit our [url=https://discord.gg/2vQQjprDcq]Discord server[/url] if you'd like to talk to us directly.
